_comment: Machine-readable gate manifest for /orchestrate. Each milestone maps to the single command that PROVES it (exit 0 = met). tier: which test tier the gate runs at. requires: host capabilities. manual: true gates run only under K3SM_LAB=1 (else reported 'pending lab', never auto-greened). Gates for unstarted milestones (m1.sh, ...) are authored as that milestone's work runs.
